This CAS server is meant to test the integration of the pac4j clients via the CAS, SAML and OIDC protocols.

  • Accounts: alice / pwd, bob / pwd
  • CAS support: url: https?://.*
  • OIDC support:
    • id: myclient, secret: mysecret, url: https?://.*
    • id: pkceclient, url: https?://.*
  • SAML support:
    • entityId: http://localhost:8081.*
    • entityId: http://localhost:8080/callback.*

For security reasons, please log out and exit your web browser when you are done accessing services that require authentication!
